header.title: NASA Earth Trend Detective
header.subtitle: Select a region via voice command or geocoded query
header.searchPlaceholder: Speak or type a region (e.g. Amazon Basin, Nicaragua...)

voice.unsupported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge, or type your query.
voice.error: Could not access microphone. Please check audio input permissions.

regionStep.title: Define Study Region
regionStep.description: Speak or type the geographic area to investigate to compute the geodetic triangle polygon.
regionStep.hint: Voice command: you can say 'Amazon Basin', 'Sahara Desert' or 'Nicaragua'.

periodStep.title: Select Time Series Window
periodStep.description: Climate trends require multi-year analysis to decouple regular seasonal cycles from genuine long-term change.
periodStep.durationNote: Recommended window: at least 5 years for statistical significance via Mann-Kendall test.

variablesStep.title: NASA Satellite Variables
variablesStep.description: Select environmental variables to calculate rate of change and evaluate scientific significance.
variablesStep.minWarning: Select at least one variable to execute trend analysis
variablesStep.varPrecipDesc: Quantifies rainfall and snowpack (GPM IMERG mission). Critical for drought and hydrological cycle shifts.
variablesStep.varTempDesc: Measures radiant thermal emission from ground (MODIS Terra/Aqua). Evaluates heat stress and ecosystem anomalies.
variablesStep.varNdviDesc: Spectral density of healthy plant canopy (MODIS). Highlights deforestation and vegetation vitality.
variablesStep.varMoistureDesc: Estimates volumetric water content in soil strata (GLDAS model). Crucial for wildfire and agricultural vulnerability.

resultsStep.title: Trend & Significance Report
resultsStep.description: Time series evaluation using linear regression, Sen slope estimator, and Mann-Kendall significance test.
resultsStep.methodology: Methodology: Seasonal decomposition + Mann-Kendall test at 95% confidence interval.
resultsStep.backendDone: GeoJSON polygon and telemetry successfully sent (inspect F12 console).
